workload.command: python -c "import timeit, dask.array as da; arr = da.arange(2000, chunks=(1,)); f = lambda *a, **k: a[0]; exec('for _ in range(5): arr = da.blockwise(f, \"i\", arr, \"i\")'); keys = arr.__dask_keys__(); t = min(timeit.repeat(lambda: arr.dask.cull(keys), number=1, repeat=5)); print(t)"
workload.source: adapted from the culling benchmark in the description of https://github.com/dask/dask/pull/11899 (a chain of blockwise layers over arange, then HighLevelGraph.cull on all keys), with timeit in place of IPython's %timeit and 2000 partitions and 5 layers
